Starting Balances — Intangible Assets

The Starting Balances screen under the Intangible Assets tab allows you to set up opening balances for your intangible assets. This is essential when you are migrating to Manager from another accounting system or when you have existing intangible assets at the start of your accounting period.

To create a new starting balance for an intangible asset:

  1. Navigate to the Intangible Assets tab.
  2. Click on Starting Balances.
  3. Click the New Starting Balance button.

IntangibleAssetsNewStartingBalance

You will be taken to the Starting Balance form for intangible assets. Here, you can enter the details of your intangible asset's starting balance.

For more information on how to complete the starting balance form, see Starting Balance for Intangible Asset Form.
